name: TeamStarWolf - macOS & Linux Attacks
description: Curated practitioner view of macOS & Linux Attacks behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Attacker techniques specific to or common on macOS and Linux endpoints and servers. Cross-tactic selection; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting). Every ID/tactic validated against the bundled ATT&CK v16 data.
